quotes.quote: Tell em nothing and practice telling em even less.
Leave it like you found it.
If I could have thrown that switch you two would have both been up on the road.
quotes.who: Bill McEwen Sr., on the frozen C9 switch at −10 °F

quotes.quote: How come railroad employees are not guaranteed 40 hours a week? — Cause we were on the extra board for all those years!
You no sooner cut away and backed off the scale and bam the buzzer was off.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, P&OV trainman and engineer, on the scale house weighers

quotes.quote: …if you hide in the cab you become invisible and no one in the yard office can see you.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on riding the ore drag on the #105 job

quotes.quote: Looked like he owned the place when he filled out his time sheet.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on conductor Elmer Picard

quotes.quote: If your car needed brake work Sam was the man. Great guy.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on conductor Sam Lacenere

quotes.quote: Larry was probably the nicest guy on the railroad. No one had a bad word to say about him.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on Larry Obusek of the #115 relief job

quotes.quote: You can tell by the smiles that it must have been an early quit!
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on Nick Niapas and Wally Latshaw after a #105 shift

quotes.quote: …with the throttle and enthusiasm both at notch 7.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on engineer Jack Burik at the throttle of P&LE 1554

quotes.quote: He will always be Mr. Burik to me.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on clerk Jack Burik Sr., his high-school business law teacher
Mark Connolly, on conductor Nick Niapas

quotes.quote: The third coffee is mine. Working the cherished #105 job on the “clean end” of the plant.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, with Don Amber and Bob “The Doctor” Paulin

quotes.quote: A bunch of us went to see him fight one night. He went the distance but lost the decision.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on engineer Scott Morrison

quotes.quote: I was outside chalking the wheel and making the cut. 10 shades of wrong here with conductor and engineer changing roles.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on Walt Cooper riding to the ore dumper with Mike Britzki at the controls

quotes.quote: Yep, that’s a yard office alright.
quotes.who: Mark Connolly, on the P&OV yard office
